collections.name: Afterlife
collections.description: Three pairs back from the other side - cobwebbed bat wings, the bare bones of a dragon and a wraith's drifting shroud. Each one moves with you like the rest of your wings.

collections.name: Shadows & Angels
collections.description: Five pairs of real 3D wings that move with you - a slow, calm wingbeat while you stand, wider strokes as you run, spread wide when you glide.

collections.name: Yuletide
collections.description: Candy canes, fresh snow and frosted feathers for the coldest nights of the year.

collections.name: Future
collections.description: Wings from tomorrow: glowing neon frames in five colours and sci-fi circuitry - pick the one that matches your setup.

collections.name: Auras
collections.description: Animated auras that live around you - stars, embers, snow, a void rift, lightning, code rain, fire, nature, hearts and northern lights. Pick a colour, size and speed.

collections.name: Velo Originals
collections.description: High-res animated capes: the Velo logo in neon, wildfire, glacier, two thunderstorms, gold glyphs - and black and white designs.

items.name: Angelic Wings
items.description: Radiant white feathers with a golden crest and a halo on top.

items.name: Bone Dragon Wings
items.description: The bare bones of a dragon's wings, claws tipped with a sickly green glow.

items.name: Cobweb Wings
items.description: Tattered bat wings strung with cobwebs, their edges smouldering orange.

items.name: Frost Wings
items.description: Wings of living ice - crystal shards over a frozen frame.

items.name: Phoenix Wings
items.description: Blazing feathers in every shade of fire, reborn with every stroke.

items.name: Raven Wings
items.description: Midnight-black feathers with a quiet blue sheen.

items.name: Shadowfang Wings
items.description: Leathery dragon wings with glowing violet claws.

items.name: Wraith Wings
items.description: A wraith's shroud torn into wings - violet wisps that trail behind you.

items.name: Digitized
items.description: Shifting black geometric weave.

items.name: Codebreaker
items.description: Scrolling red code cascades down the fabric.

items.name: Storm Strike
items.description: Crackling red lightning arcs across the cloth.

items.name: Rune Weave
items.description: Animated arcane symbols drift and glow.

items.name: Candy Cane Wings
items.description: Striped candy-cane frames wrapped in evergreen, ready for the holidays.

items.name: Snowdrift Wings
items.description: Soft feathers dusted with fresh snow and glittering frost.

items.name: Neon White Wings
items.description: Glowing white neon light traced along sharp wing frames.

items.name: Neon Cyan Wings
items.description: Glowing cyan neon light traced along sharp wing frames.

items.name: Neon Pink Wings
items.description: Glowing pink neon light traced along sharp wing frames.

items.name: Neon Purple Wings
items.description: Glowing purple neon light traced along sharp wing frames.

items.name: Neon Red Wings
items.description: Glowing red neon light traced along sharp wing frames.

items.name: Celestial Orbit
items.description: Three tilted rings of stars circle you, each trailing a comet tail.

items.name: Ember Spiral
items.description: Embers spiral up from your feet in a double helix and drift away as you move.

items.name: Frost Halo
items.description: A crown of glittering ice above your head and soft snow falling all around you.

items.name: Void Rift
items.description: A pulsing rune circle at your feet pulls dark wisps in from all around.

items.name: Storm Sparks
items.description: Lightning arcs crackle around your body and throw off bright sparks.

items.name: Code Rain
items.description: Glowing green code rains down a cylinder of light around you - digits and glyphs flicker as they fall.

items.name: Inferno
items.description: A roaring column of fire licks up around you, white-hot at your feet, throwing sparks into the air.

items.name: Bloom
items.description: Vines spiral up around you, leaf out and burst into glowing flowers while fireflies blink and petals drift down.

items.name: Heartbeat
items.description: A ring of hearts pulses to a heartbeat around you as more hearts float up and fade.

items.name: Aurora
items.description: Northern-lights curtains wave around you in green, cyan and violet, with stars rising through them.

items.name: Hologram
items.description: A hexagon plate glows under you while scan rings sweep up your body, data glyphs orbit and bits of light rise.

items.name: Festive
items.description: A garland of Christmas lights spirals up around you, baubles circle, a star shines above and snow drifts down.

items.name: Velo Neon
items.description: The Velo logo traced in red neon - sparks race around it over a scrolling synthwave grid. Free: join the Velo Discord and link your account.

items.name: Wildfire
items.description: Flames roll up the cape and embers drift into the air.

items.name: Glacier
items.description: Ice crystals spread across a frozen cape, a shimmer sweeps over them and frost twinkles.

items.name: Thunderstrike
items.description: Violet storm clouds and rain - then forked purple lightning tears down the cape and lights up the sky.

items.name: Hieroglyph
items.description: Gold glyphs on obsidian light up in waves while a highlight runs round the border.

items.name: Crimson Storm
items.description: Blood-red storm clouds and rain, split by red lightning that lights up the whole sky.

items.name: Obsidian
items.description: Glossy black stone with faint silver veins - an oil-slick sheen glides across it.

items.name: Eclipse
items.description: A black sun among faint stars - its corona pulses and a flare licks round the rim.

items.name: Phantom
items.description: Wisps of dark smoke rise up the cape, glowing faintly violet at their edges.

items.name: Kintsugi
items.description: Black porcelain mended with gold - a glint of light runs down the golden cracks.

items.name: Heaven
items.description: Soft white clouds drift by while golden rays of light fan down from above.

items.name: Pearl
items.description: Iridescent pearl white - pastel colours shift with the light and sparkles come and go.

items.name: Haunted
items.description: Ghosts drift up out of a misty graveyard under the full moon.

items.name: Jack o'Lantern
items.description: A carved pumpkin grins out of the dark, its face flickering with candlelight as smoke curls up.

items.name: Witching Hour
items.description: Bats flap across a huge orange moon behind a crooked dead tree.

items.name: Silent Night
items.description: Snow falls on a sleeping forest - a cabin's windows glow, the Christmas star shines and an aurora drifts overhead.

items.name: Festive Lights
items.description: Strings of Christmas lights twinkle and chase across deep green velvet while snow drifts past.

items.name: Gift Wrap
items.description: Red paper with silver snowflakes, tied with a gold satin bow that catches the light.

items.name: Velo Staff
items.description: Worn only by the Velo Client team - the Velo logo and STAFF in crisp white over matte black, a red line breathing beneath.

items.name: Booster
items.description: For everyone who boosts the Velo Discord - a cut pink gem catching a sweep of light among rising bokeh.

items.name: Circuit
items.description: A dark board etched with glowing cyan traces - data pulses race along the circuits and through the chips.

items.name: Holo Grid
items.description: A hologram of hexagon cells lighting up in a slow wave from cyan to violet, with a scan line sweeping through.

items.name: Sci-Fi Circuit Wings
items.description: Glowing circuit lines pulse along a sharp sci-fi wing frame.

items.name: Ice Star Wings
items.description: Frozen crystal feathers tipped with glittering ice stars.
